run_img2img_pipeline: run the StableDiffusionImg2ImgPipeline to generate an image from a prompt and input image with a given strength
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the encode_prompt method of the pipeline
prepare_latents_from_image: prepare noisy latent variables from an input image using the prepare_latents method for img2img generation
validate_img2img_inputs: validate the prompt, strength, and callback inputs using the check_inputs method of the pipeline
retrieve_timesteps_for_scheduler: retrieve and configure the timestep schedule for a diffusion scheduler using the retrieve_timesteps function
